description_en: Adds a data source to DataWorks
description_zh: 该接口用于创建DataWorks数据源
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-data-source --project-id 1 --name abc --data-source-type rds --env-type 1 --content database_:_dbname_,_instanceName_:_instancename_,_password_:_password_,_rdsOwnerId_:_123_,_username_:_username --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDataSource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the data source belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据源所在的DataWorks工作空间ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html接口获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the data source
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

odps
mysql
rds
oss
sqlserver
polardb
oracle
mongodb
emr
postgresql
analyticdb_for_mysql
hybriddb_for_postgresql
holo
parameters.help_zh:
数据源的类型。常用类型如下：
odps
mysql
rds
oss
sqlserver
polardb
oracle
mongodb
emr
postgresql
analyticdb_for_mysql
hybriddb_for_postgresql
holo
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The subtype of the data source.

This parameter takes effect only if you set the DataSourceType parameter to rds.
If the DataSourceType parameter is set to rds, this parameter can be set to mysql, sqlserver, or postgresql
parameters.help_zh:
数据源的子类型。使用如下：

当DataSourceType参数配置为RDS时，SubType参数生效。
如果DataSourceType参数配置为RDS，SubType参数支持配置为mysql、sqlserver或postgresql
parameters.name: sub_type

parameters.help_en: The environment in which the data source is used. Valid values: 0 and 1. The value 0 indicates the development environment. The value 1 indicates the production environment
parameters.help_zh: 数据源所属的环境，包括0（开发环境）和1（生产环境）
parameters.name: env_type
